title: Piano in the Pirate Hours
description: A chord-led 2-step garage roller at 130 BPM: shuffled LinnDrum breaks and choked hats under bright felt-piano stabs, a pumping pad and a chopped diva vocal that gets denser toward each peak. It climbs to a euphoric first drop, drops into a hushed pad valley, then surges into a brighter second peak before a delay-soaked outro.
